name: Hano Yoshihiro
source:
[url=/c2207]Sora's[/url] kouhai and [url=/c2211]Gaku's[/url] best friend. A ghost member of the chemistry club.

He is a caring person and makes lunches everyday for Gaku while living in the dormitory. It seems that he's had a problem recently.
